# CartPanda Help Center

> > CartPanda is an e-commerce checkout and order management platform with integrated payment processing (CartPanda Pay), affiliate marketing, conversion tracking, and shipping solutions.

CartPanda helps merchants sell physical and digital products with features like custom domain checkout, Facebook/Taboola pixel tracking, affiliate management, Link Bundler for product kits, and multi-gateway payment processing including ACH, Wire, and Payoneer withdrawals.

## Key Topics

- CartPanda Pay - Integrated payment processing and withdrawals
- Order Management - Processing, tracking, and CSV import/export
- Conversion Tracking - Facebook Pixel, Taboola Pixel, S2S Postback
- Affiliate System - Producer and affiliate marketplace with commissions
- Link Bundler - Product bundles and kits
- Shipping Integration - Melhor Envio, Frenet, Intelipost, Mandaê
- Custom Domain - CNAME and SSL configuration
- Checkout Optimization - Campaign tracking and advertising integration
- Payment Methods - ACH, International Wire, Payoneer
- Physical Products - Variants and Shopify import
- ShipOffers - Nutraceutical product integration
- JivoChat - Customer support integration
- CartPanda Ranks - Season runs and leaderboards
- Multi-currency - BRL and USD support

## Getting Started

- [Dashboard - home page](https://help.cartpanda.com/en-us/article/dashboard-home-page-1bi2ewv): Getting started guide for CartPanda dashboard navigation and features
- [Visão geral da sua conta](https://help.cartpanda.com/pt-br/article/visao-geral-da-sua-conta-1natxqg): Overview of Cartpanda account settings and dashboard configuration
- [Add Your Custom Domain to CartPanda](https://help.cartpanda.com/en-us/article/add-your-custom-domain-to-cartpanda-1q9q1yu): Configure custom domain DNS with CNAME and SSL for checkout

## Product Management

- [Criando um produto físico](https://help.cartpanda.com/pt-br/article/criando-um-produto-fisico-rgya2r): Create physical products with variants in CartPanda or import from Shopify
- [Link Bundler](https://help.cartpanda.com/pt-br/article/link-bundler-m1plva): Create product bundles and kits with Link Bundler for checkout

## Order Management

- [Manage your orders](https://help.cartpanda.com/en-us/article/manage-your-orders-1hg82rb): Process orders with filters, timeline tracking, and CSV export/import
- [Gerencie seus pedidos](https://help.cartpanda.com/pt-br/article/gerencie-seus-pedidos-e5sbif): Manage, process, and export orders with filters and tracking
- [Create and duplicate orders](https://help.cartpanda.com/en-us/article/create-and-duplicate-orders-1n23x56): Manually create or duplicate orders in CartPanda dashboard
- [Alterar número do pedido](https://help.cartpanda.com/pt-br/article/alterar-numero-do-pedido-1qn4nsu): Customize order number format with prefix and suffix settings

## Payment Processing

- [Como efetuar um saque no Cartpanda Pay](https://help.cartpanda.com/pt-br/article/como-efetuar-um-saque-no-cartpanda-pay-1nt5wgv): Withdraw funds from Cartpanda Pay via ACH, Wire, or Payoneer

## Shipping Configuration

- [Configure o frete da sua loja](https://help.cartpanda.com/pt-br/article/configure-o-frete-da-sua-loja-li5szb): Setup shipping rates with Melhor Envio, Frenet, Intelipost, or Mandaê

## Conversion Tracking & Analytics

- [Como localizar e criar seu Pixel ID do Facebook](https://help.cartpanda.com/pt-br/article/como-localizar-e-criar-seu-pixel-id-do-facebook-myujal): Locate or create Facebook Pixel ID in Meta Business Events Manager
- [Configure o Pixel do Taboola](https://help.cartpanda.com/pt-br/article/configure-o-pixel-do-taboola-105ydjd): Configure Taboola Pixel tracking for conversion and campaign optimization
- [S2S Postback](https://help.cartpanda.com/en-us/article/s2s-postback-vgih0a): Server-to-server postback tracking for affiliates and vendors

## Affiliate System

- [Para afiliados: Sistema de Afiliados Cartpanda](https://help.cartpanda.com/pt-br/article/para-afiliados-sistema-de-afiliados-cartpanda-1tjc1hp): Join Cartpanda affiliate system and earn commissions via Marketplace
- [Para produtores: Como aprovar ou rejeitar afiliados](https://help.cartpanda.com/pt-br/article/para-produtores-como-aprovar-ou-rejeitar-afiliados-1p9ywqp): Approve or reject affiliates manually or automatically as a producer

## Integrations

- [ShipOffers integration guide](https://help.cartpanda.com/en-us/article/shipoffers-integration-guide-lzdpzm): Integrate ShipOffers for nutraceutical products with SKU configuration
- [JivoChat](https://help.cartpanda.com/pt-br/article/jivochat-1e2r1i8): Configure JivoChat customer support integration in CartPanda
